value.title: Automatic responses for router lookup results with the standard error body (wave 4, restated in wave 8)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Through the harness, a request whose path matches no route is answered `404` with the standard error body of FR-APP-006 (`code` `NOT_FOUND`). [D-395; wave-4 carried: standard error body; D-134] Decision: the fallback answers only a response that is still `NEW`, through the request's `Response`, keeping the headers a middleware set; a response that is no longer `NEW` is left as it is. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-4-4 SDS-AC-15]

With only `POST /p` registered, `GET /p` is answered `405` with `Allow` listing `POST, OPTIONS`, and with `GET /r` registered `DELETE /r` is answered `405` with `Allow` including the automatic `HEAD` and `OPTIONS`, both with the standard error body (`code` `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`). [D-395; T02; D-134] Decision: the `Allow` value joins the allowed methods (or `Method.any()` for `OPTIONS *`) with `, ` in `MethodSet` iteration (`Method` declaration) order.

With `GET /r` and `POST /r` registered and no `OPTIONS` route, `OPTIONS /r` is answered `204` with `Allow` = `GET, HEAD, POST, OPTIONS`, no body and no `Content-Length` header. [D-395; T05; wave decision: Automatic response bodies]

`TRACE /x` with `TRACE` disabled and `CONNECT /` with `CONNECT` disabled are each answered `501` with the standard error body (`code` `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`) after the global middleware ran, while a request with an unrecognised method token (FR-ROUTE-013) is answered `501` with the standard error body before any `Request` is built, as FR-HTTP-021 AC-4 states. [D-395; wave decision: 426 and 501; wave decision: Pre-request rejections; D-422] Decision: the dispatcher tells the two cases apart by whether the method token parses to a `Method` value.

With a WebSocket-only route registered through the internal hook of FR-HTTP-008 AC-7, a plain `GET` to that path is answered `426` with headers `Upgrade: websocket` and `Connection: Upgrade` and the standard error body (`code` `UPGRADE_REQUIRED`), asserted through the in-memory adapter. [D-395; T06; wave decision: 426 over TinyHttpd; wave decision: 426 and 501] Decision: the upgrade flag passed to the lookup is `Router.isWebSocketUpgrade(token, Connection, Upgrade)` with each header's values joined by `, `.

On a WebSocket-only hook route, a `GET` carrying `Upgrade: websocket` and `Connection: Upgrade` is handled by the WebSocket handshake of FR-WS-001 AC-7 (answered `101` with no `426`), while a `GET` without `Upgrade` on such a route is answered `426` with both headers and the standard error body (FR-WS-004 AC-1). [D-395; T06; FR-ROUTE-015; wave decision: FR-WS-001 AC-7]

After `app.route(Method.any().except(Method.DELETE), "/t", h)`, `DELETE /t` through the in-memory harness is answered `405` with `Allow` = `GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, OPTIONS` (the router's `Method` declaration order, FR-ROUTE-010 AC-1) and the standard error body. [D-395; T02]

A recording global middleware runs once before each of the `404`, `405`, `426`, automatic `OPTIONS` and disabled-`TRACE`/`CONNECT` `501` answers above and not for the unrecognised-token `501`, and a recording `onError` records no call for any of them. [wave decision: Pre-request rejections; residual: onError scope; D-117]

verificationEvidence.notes: command: ./gradlew build; result: pass; asserts 426 with both headers for the plain GET and 101 for the upgrade GET

changeNotes.reason: Restates FR-HTTP-022 after the expiry of its AC-6; ACs 1-5, 7, 8 carried over unchanged
Behavior unchanged since FR-HTTP-022; tests cite the successor
./gradlew build --rerun-tasks passed (1561 tests, 0 failures); every AC cited by a passing test and evidenced

value.requirement: The system shall, after the global and prefix middleware ran, answer the no-match result with `404`, the method-mismatch result with `405` and an `Allow` header, the automatic-OPTIONS result with `204` and an `Allow` header, the unsupported-method result for a disabled `TRACE` or `CONNECT` (a `Method` value) with `501` and the WebSocket-only result with `426` plus `Upgrade: websocket` and `Connection: Upgrade`, where the `404`, `405`, `426` and `501` answers carry the standard error body and the `204` answers carry no body, while an unrecognised method token stays a pre-request rejection answered `501` before any `Request` is built (FR-HTTP-021).
